# python-course.eu

> > Comprehensive free Python tutorials and online courses for self-study, from fundamentals to advanced topics including OOP, machine learning, and numerical programming.

python-course.eu offers detailed online Python education covering beginner to advanced levels, with content created by Bernd Klein and Bodenseo. The site includes practical projects, live courses, and professional PDF eBook versions for learners worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Python fundamentals
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
- Machine Learning
- Numerical Programming
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Advanced Python
- Type Hints & Annotations
- Tkinter GUI
- Data Analysis
- Deep Learning
- Functional Programming
- Generators
- Web Development
- System Programming

## Core Python Tutorials

- [Intro to Python Tutorial](https://python-course.eu/python-tutorial): Detailed online introduction course into Python programming suitable for self-study.
- [For Loops](https://python-course.eu/python-tutorial/for-loops.php): Introduction to for loops and iteration in Python with range examples.
- [Intro to Object Oriented Programming](https://python-course.eu/oop): Introduction to Object Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts with Python.
- [Intro to Advanced Python](https://python-course.eu/advanced-python): Advanced Python topics including functional programming and generators.
- [Annotations](https://python-course.eu/annotations): Guide to Python type hints and annotations for improved code quality.

## Data Science & Numerical Programming

- [Numerical Programming with Python](https://python-course.eu/numerical-programming): Overview of NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for numerical computing.
- [Intro to Machine Learning with Python](https://python-course.eu/machine-learning): Machine Learning tutorial with examples using NumPy, SciPy, and Pandas.
- [Multi-level Indexing in Pandas](https://python-course.eu/numerical-programming/multi-level-indexing-in-pandas.php): Advanced Pandas tutorial on multi-level indexing and hierarchical data.
- [Pandas Groupby Example](https://python-course.eu/numerical-programming/pandas-groupby-example.php): Extensive Pandas groupby example for CSV data aggregation and analysis.
- [Pandas Styling](https://python-course.eu/numerical-programming/pandas-styling.php): Guide to Pandas DataFrame styling for data formatting and visualization.

## Applications & Projects

- [Introduction to Applications of Python](https://python-course.eu/applications-python): Python applications including system programming, graphs, and state machines.
- [Tkinter - the Python interface for Tk](https://python-course.eu/tkinter): Tutorial to Tkinter, the most commonly used Python GUI framework.
- [Introduction | Projects](https://python-course.eu/projects): Small projects to practice Python skills across beginner to advanced levels.
